title: Pure macropore volume-under-level source equation

source.behavior: Accumulate macropore compartment volumes upward from ICZbt+1 until Ztp is reached, then subtract the overshoot fraction in the last intersected compartment.

scope: one source equation with explicit geometry/thickness/compartment-volume arrays
preserve B1.11 loop order and floating-point expression order
fail closed on malformed shapes, nonfinite coordinates and nonpositive thickness
100,000 deterministic bitwise comparisons at O0 and O2
non_goals: MACRORATE flow coupling or global state migration
